pages.text: The Potion Table brews $(4)Akaishi Potions$(0) from samples of purity 25+, and each potion inherits the sample's purity and creature source.$(br2)$(bold)Two recipes:$(0)$(li)$(4)Permanent Potion$(0): 3 solidified essence + 20,000 life energy, 60 ticks (3 seconds)$(li)$(4)Breakthrough Potion$(0): 5 solidified essence + 30,000 life energy, 80 ticks (4 seconds)$(br2)Learn what each potion does (next page) before deciding what to brew; for storing the finished potions, see "$(l:akaishi:life_vaults)Vaults$(/l)".

$(bold)Permanent Potion = absorb a genotype:$(0) writes that creature's genes into your body, giving $(4)every organ of that source +N effective compatibility$(0) — tiered by purity in steps of 20: +3 / +6 / +9 / +12 / +15.$(br2)$(li)Each source can be absorbed only once in a lifetime$(li)At most 4 genotypes at once; unload one and you may absorb it again$(br2)$(bold)Breakthrough Potion = temporary awakening:$(0) requires that source already absorbed AND one of its non-native organs transplanted.$(li)Active for 30 minutes, one at a time$(li)+2 / +4 / +6 / +8 extra compatibility and +10% / +20% / +30% / +40% enhancement (by purity tier)$(br2)Check and unload absorbed genotypes at the Gene Manager on the next page.

The Rejection Neutralizer is your $(4)first-aid$(0) for transplant rejection.$(br2)$(bold)Effects:$(0)$(li)Each bottle cuts rejection by −12 in every organ slot$(li)You can drink it repeatedly, but only the first 6 bottles count per transplant period$(li)15-second cooldown between drinks$(br2)$(c)Slots lock-sealed by a natural-enemy conflict are excluded$(0) — remove one conflicting side first.$(br2)Plain and simple: when rejection nears the danger line, drink one to "wash" it back to safety — don't wait for the backlash.

The Gene Manager is your gene filing cabinet.$(br2)$(li)View absorbed genotypes and their current state$(li)Unload a source's gene: the bonus is removed and a slot frees up — you can then $(4)re-absorb$(0) it by drinking another Permanent Potion$(br2)Want a different gene setup? Unload here first, then start over.

Suggested order: high-purity samples come from "Samples & Genes"; these potions serve the organs built in "Organ Construction"; check rejection with "Body & Decay"; keep the finished potions in the vault system.
